def main():
    solver = Solver()
    categories = {
        "name": ["Arnold", "Eric", "Peter"],
        "genre": ["mystery", "romance", "science fiction"],
        "phone": ["google pixel 6", "iphone 13", "samsung galaxy s21"],
        "height": ["short", "very short", "average"],
        "flower": ["daffodils", "lilies", "carnations"],
        "lunch": ["pizza", "grilled cheese", "spaghetti"],
    }
    variables = {}
    for category, values in categories.items():
        category_vars = {}
        for value in values:
            var_name = f"{category}_{value.replace(' ', '_')}"
            var = Int(var_name)
            category_vars[value] = var
            solver.add(var >= 0, var <= 2)
        solver.add(Distinct(list(category_vars.values())))
        variables[category] = category_vars

    name = variables["name"]
    genre = variables["genre"]
    phone = variables["phone"]
    height = variables["height"]
    flower = variables["flower"]
    lunch = variables["lunch"]

    solver.add(phone["samsung galaxy s21"] == height["short"])
    solver.add(flower["carnations"] + 1 == phone["iphone 13"])
    solver.add(name["Peter"] == genre["romance"])

    solver.add(flower["daffodils"] == height["very short"])
    solver.add(phone["samsung galaxy s21"] == genre["science fiction"])

    solver.add(name["Arnold"] == 2)
    solver.add(name["Peter"] == height["very short"])

            f"{attribute_at('genre', house_index)}, "
            f"{attribute_at('phone', house_index)}, "
            f"{attribute_at('height', house_index)}, "
            f"{attribute_at('flower', house_index)}, "
            f"{attribute_at('lunch', house_index)}"
        )

if __name__ == "__main__":

from z3 import *

def main():
    houses = range(2)
    names = ["Arnold", "Eric"]
    heights = ["short", "very short"]
    pets = ["cat", "dog"]
    nationalities = ["brit", "dane"]
    colors = ["yellow", "red"]
    mothers = ["Aniya", "Holly"]

    s = Solver()

    def make_vars(prefix, values):
        vars = [Int(f"{prefix}_{h}") for h in houses]
        for v in vars:
            s.add(Or(*[v == i for i in range(len(values))]))
        s.add(Distinct(*vars))
        return vars

    name = make_vars("name", names)
    height = make_vars("height", heights)
    pet = make_vars("pet", pets)
    nat = make_vars("nat", nationalities)
    color = make_vars("color", colors)
    mother = make_vars("mother", mothers)

    # clue 1
    s.add(height[1] == heights.index("short"))
    # clue 2
    for h in houses:
        s.add(Eq(name[h] == names.index("Eric"), nat[h] == nationalities.index("dane")))
    # clue 3
    for h in houses:
        s.add(Eq(color[h] == colors.index("red"), name[h] == names.index("Arnold")))
    # clue 4
    s.add(mother[0] == mothers.index("Holly"))
    s.add(nat[1] == nationalities.index("brit"))
    # clue 5
    for h in houses:
        s.add(Eq(mother[h] == mothers.index("Holly"), pet[h] == pets.index("cat")))

    if s.check() != sat:
        return
    m = s.model()
    for h in houses:
        vals = [
            names[m[name[h]].as_long()],
            heights[m[height[h]].as_long()],
            pets[m[pet[h]].as_long()],
            nationalities[m[nat[h]].as_long()],
            colors[m[color[h]].as_long()],
            mothers[m[mother[h]].as_long()],
        ]

```python
from z3 import *

def main():
    names = ["Arnold", "Peter", "Bob", "Eric", "Alice"]
    hairs = ["gray", "brown", "black", "red", "blonde"]
    vacations = ["city", "mountain", "camping", "cruise", "beach"]
    flowers = ["roses", "tulips", "carnations", "lilies", "daffodils"]
    lunches = ["stew", "stir fry", "spaghetti", "pizza", "grilled cheese"]
    hobbies = ["painting", "photography", "gardening", "knitting", "cooking"]

    cats = {
        "name": names,
        "hair": hairs,
        "vacation": vacations,
        "flower": flowers,
        "lunch": lunches,
        "hobby": hobbies,
    }

    s = Solver()
    pos = {}
    for cat, values in cats.items():
        pos[cat] = {}
        for v in values:
            var = Int(f"{cat}_{v.replace(' ', '_')}")
            pos[cat][v] = var
            s.add(var >= 1, var <= 5)
        s.add(AllDifferent([pos[cat][v] for v in values]))

    def same(cat1, v1, cat2, v2):
        return pos[cat1][v1] == pos[cat2][v2]

    def directly_left(cat1, v1, cat2, v2):
        return pos[cat1][v1] + 1 == pos[cat2][v2]

    def left_of(cat1, v1, cat2, v2):
        return pos[cat1][v1] < pos[cat2][v2]

    s.add(directly_left("lunch", "stew", "flower", "tulips"))
    s.add(same("vacation", "camping", "lunch", "grilled cheese"))
    s.add(left_of("hair", "black", "name", "Bob"))
    s.add(same("hobby", "photography", "hair", "gray"))
    s.add(same("lunch", "pizza", "vacation", "cruise"))
    s.add(same("name", "Alice", "vacation", "city"))
    s.add(directly_left("vacation", "beach", "hobby", "painting"))
    s.add(same("name", "Arnold", "lunch", "spaghetti"))
    s.add(pos["name"]["Bob"] == 5)
    s.add(pos["flower"]["lilies"] == 3)
    s.add(pos["hobby"]["knitting"] == 4)
    s.add(directly_left("hair", "brown", "hobby", "painting"))
    s.add(Abs(pos["vacation"]["cruise"] - pos["hobby"]["knitting"]) == 3)
    s.add(same("hair", "red", "lunch", "spaghetti"))
    s.add(pos["flower"]["carnations"] != 2)
    s.add(left_of("name", "Eric", "hobby", "gardening"))
    s.add(same("hobby", "photography", "lunch", "stew"))
    s.add(same("name", "Eric", "flower", "daffodils"))

    if s.check() != sat:
        return

    m = s.model()
    def value_at(cat, v, house):
        return m.eval(pos[cat][v], model_completion=True).as_long() == house

    for house in range(1, 6):
        attrs = []
        for cat in ["name", "hair", "vacation", "flower", "lunch", "hobby"]:
            for v in cats[cat]:
                if value_at(cat, v, house):
                    attrs.append(v)
                    break
        print(f"House {house}: " + ", ".join(attrs))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

def same_house(cat1, idx1, cat2, idx2):
    return Or([And(cat1[i] == idx1, cat2[i] == idx2) for i in range(6)])

def next_to(cat1, idx1, cat2, idx2):
    return Or([And(cat1[i] == idx1, cat2[j] == idx2) for i in range(6) for j in range(6) if abs(i - j) == 1])

def left_of(cat1, idx1, cat2, idx2):
    return Or([And(cat1[i] == idx1, cat2[j] == idx2) for i in range(6) for j in range(6) if i < j])

def directly_left(cat1, idx1, cat2, idx2):
    return Or([And(cat1[i] == idx1, cat2[j] == idx2) for i in range(6) for j in range(6) if j == i + 1])

def between_one(cat1, idx1, cat2, idx2):
